review: Detailed location, area exposure, weapon targeting, restrained capture and elevation rules inventoried through the start of advanced unarmed techniques. Existing location tables remain separate shared requirements; geometry and rounding audits pending.

entries.acceptance: Ordinary attacks default to torso unless another location or random targeting is declared. Unaimed attacks require random locations, large-area attacks use exposure rules, and fatigue damage ignores location.

Reconcile each detailed humanoid location with B552 inventory: vital-organ damage-type eligibility, skull armor and toxic exception, eye crippling, facial corrosion, neck multipliers, groin-specific anatomy, limb caps and shield-side penalties. One shared location resolver must serve both chapters.

Tight-beam burning means ranged burning that is neither jet, cone, area, explosion nor follow-up. It may target eyes/vitals, but divides damage by ten only for ignition procedures, not ordinary injury.
Body-part grapples halve location penalties and round up under the printed convention; verify negative-penalty rounding against worked definitions. This reduction does not apply to grabbing a weapon.

Declared random target has no location attack modifier. Roll location only after attack succeeds and defense fails, using actual body-form table. Do not consume location randomness on misses or successful defense.
For random hits from directly above, convert feet to hands and legs to arms; preserve side and actual anatomy constraints.

Dispersed/uniform bodies ignore location wound and knockdown modifiers but retain eye/limb crippling. Missing locations cannot be deliberately targeted. Brain/vitals/nonliving exceptions resolve through the actual anatomy model, not one universal damage reduction.

Area effects, cones and external explosions use large-area injury. A body-scaled/unarmed melee attack with attacker size at least seven greater also does; such attacker can choose a location only against pinned or immobile victim.

Effective large-area armor is ceil((torso armor + lowest exposed location armor)/2), evaluated for this damage type. Covered or body-masked locations are excluded; directional blasts/cones expose facing surfaces, immersion only immersed parts, true area effects all parts.

Large-area injury normally uses torso wound behavior. With only one exposed location use that location; exposed limb damage is capped under crippling rules. Distinguish exposed-set calculation from random targeting.

Gap targeting requires piercing, impaling or tight-beam burning. Use -8 torso or -10 elsewhere instead of ordinary location penalty; halve protection cumulatively with divisors. Resolve rounding and actual armor weak points before execution.

Declare disarm or destruction before attacking a weapon. Target penalty is -5 for close-reach/pistol, -4 for reach-one/medium firearm, -3 for reach-two-or-more/rifle. Extra disarm penalty is separately conditional.

Close weapon occupies wielder hex; reach-one weapon also front hex; reach-two/three weapon occupies forward line of that length. On first turn after a long weapon attacks or feints at actor, that actor can strike it despite ordinary spatial reach; retain attack history and reconcile diagram geometry.
Weapon target can be dodged or parried only with the attacked ready weapon, never blocked or defended using another weapon. Retreat can apply; shield defense bonus cannot.
Only attacks using a parry-capable weapon can disarm. Extra -2 attack penalty applies except specified fencing weapons. Validate actual attack mode rather than just possession of a disarming skill.

After hit and failed defense, quick contest weapon skills; defender uses dexterity for missile weapon. Either may use strength-based skill when better. Actual hook/whip-skill use adds two to attacker; two-handed target adds two to defender.

Attacker victory sends target weapon one yard in random direction. Defender win/tie retains it but leaves it unready unless victory margin at least three. Attacker critical failure disarms attacker instead. Update actual hands and item world position once.

Destructive weapon targeting uses ordinary damage against object armor/capacity and material. Purchased gadget abilities use their gadget rules. Do not confuse successful contact with automatic breakage.

Actor may choose lower strength for unarmed, melee, thrown, bow or sling attack, but not crossbow/firearm. Declare before rolling and preserve relevant weapon constraints; lower attack strength does not permanently change character attributes.
Flat of swing-cutting weapon converts to crushing. Blunt end of thrust-impaling weapon converts to crushing and subtracts one damage; reversing reach-two-or-more weapon requires ready action.
After pin, binding with rope takes about sixty seconds, with ready cuffs two. Track actual restraints and interruption; successful pin does not instantly create permanent restraint.
Non-damaging suffocation requires an actually restrained, unconscious or unresisting victim and suitable means. Use the shared suffocation episode instead of invented direct injury.

Conscious suffocating actor may cease resisting with will check and attempt acting against attacker intelligence to appear unconscious, generally after at least ten seconds. Author supplies whether foe is hasty/squeamish and response; avoid guaranteed escape.

Compare stealth with victim vision. Ordinary overhead inattention gives vision -2; explicit upward attention gives +2 overhead but -2 same-level detection. Peripheral vision gives no special benefit. Attacker victory denies defense; otherwise defender takes -2 and a warned defender can prepare stop-thrust.

Dropping to attack uses a special step and -2 attack. Falls over two yards still cause landing damage regardless of attack result, with actual acrobatics/fall-reduction capabilities. Landing on victim resolves collision separately; victim is soft unless armor at least three.
Each yard of reach beyond one reduces effective vertical separation by three feet for that actor only. Do not grant reciprocal reach or globally move the participants closer.

At over six feet effective separation ordinary melee is unavailable. Author can approve a concrete posture/geometry exception, such as leaning prone lowering effective separation three feet while exposing head/arm. Record actual modifiers, exposed locations and permissions before rolls.
Positive size advantage adds one per size step to grappling attacks. Equal size gains no bonus; integrate actual target size without double-counting ordinary location targeting.
Vertical separation zero through one foot: No elevation modifiers.
Effective vertical separation greater than 1 through 2 feet: With locations enabled, upper actor has -2 to legs/feet and +1 head/neck; lower actor +2 legs/feet and -2 head. Otherwise no modifiers.
Effective vertical separation greater than 2 through 3 feet: Retain preceding location modifiers; upper defense +1 and lower defense -1.
Effective vertical separation greater than 3 through 4 feet: Upper cannot target lower legs/feet; upper defense +2 and lower -2, retaining other applicable location modifiers.

Effective vertical separation greater than 4 through 5 feet: Lower cannot target upper head; upper cannot target lower legs/feet; upper defense +3 and lower -3. Reconcile inherited location modifiers explicitly.
Effective vertical separation greater than 5 through 6 feet: Upper may target only head, lower only legs/feet, with no special attack bonuses/penalties; upper defense +3 and lower -3.
Size +1 adds 0 yards to upper reach only. Close reach becomes reach one despite zero numeric addition.
Size +2 adds 1 yards to upper reach only. Preserve lower reach and grip choices.
Size +3 adds 2 yards to upper reach only. Preserve lower reach and grip choices.
Size +4 adds 3 yards to upper reach only. Preserve lower reach and grip choices.
Size +5 adds 5 yards to upper reach only. Preserve lower reach and grip choices.
Size +6 adds 7 yards to upper reach only. Preserve lower reach and grip choices.
Size +7 adds 10 yards to upper reach only. Preserve lower reach and grip choices.
Size +8 adds 15 yards to upper reach only. Preserve lower reach and grip choices.
Size +9 adds 20 yards to upper reach only. Preserve lower reach and grip choices.
Size +10 adds 30 yards to upper reach only. Preserve lower reach and grip choices.

exclusions.reason: Earlier mounted/aerial continuation is in special-mobility inventory. Advanced unarmed techniques beginning B403 require a separate pass.
